_real_world.class: Generic PLAN shipborne electronic support measures (ESM) suite, designation not public
_real_world.variant_scope: Fujian, Type 055, Type 052D/052DL, Type 054A, Type 054B (all escorts); no PLAN-specific ESM designation or performance figure is public for any of these hulls in the OOB.
public_equipment: shipborne ESM suite (designation and performance not public for any PLAN surface combatant in this OOB)

_provenance.modeling_note: Per task instruction, a proxy ESM record is written since the OOB carries no PLAN ESM designation or performance figures for any escort class (the OOB's EW/decoys entries only mention the Type 055's unspecified 'EW suite' and Type 726-4 decoy launchers, both C-only, with no ESM-specific data). This single generic module is shared across all PLAN surface combatants in this packet, following the repo's own convention (SLQ-32_Passive_ESM_MVP reused across multiple US hulls where no ship-specific variant exists), scaled down slightly from the US SLQ-32B(V)6/SEWIP module given the total absence of any PLAN-specific figure.

sensor.type.note: no PLAN ESM designation is public for any hull in this packet; ESM is the matching engine sensor type for the qualitative 'EW suite' mentioned for Type 055 (C-only, csg-cn-type055-wiki)

sensor.max_range.note: no public detection range for any PLAN shipborne ESM; engineering-estimate proxy scaled slightly below the repo's US SLQ-32B(V)6/SEWIP CSG module, reflecting the complete absence of PLAN-specific sourcing

sensor.fov_deg.note: copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family ESM module convention

sensor.scan_period.note: copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family ESM module convention

sensor.detection_prob.note: copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family ESM module convention

sensor.bearing_noise_std.note: copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family ESM module convention

sensor.range_noise_std.note: 0.0: bearing-only ESM has no independent range measurement, copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family convention

sensor.track_memory_s.note: copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family ESM module convention

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent, standard engine default, copied from template

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, copied from template

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: 0.0: not applicable to a passive ESM receiver, copied from template

sensor.reference_snr_db.note: radar-equation calibration constant copied from the SLQ-32-family template, paired with reference_range_m/reference_rcs_m2

sensor.reference_range_m.note: paired calibration constant, see reference_snr_db; copied from template

sensor.reference_rcs_m2.note: 5 m^2 generic reference emitter/RCS, engine convention, copied from template

sensor.bearing_only.note: true: ESM systems detect and bear emitters passively, no independent ranging; standard convention for this sensor type

sensor.bearing_only_min_range_m.note: copied from the repo's SLQ-32-family ESM module convention

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne ESM suite per authoring standard

modeling_notes: Single shared proxy record for all 5 hull types in this packet per task instruction ('an ESM set per class, proxy if not public'); no distinguishing PLAN-specific data exists to differentiate a per-hull ESM fit.
